recent_trades.time_basis: Entry is the next candle open. Exit is that candle's end (open plus the bar size). Free OHLCV has no intrabar fill time.
recent_trades.strategy_name: Buy the dip when price is 60–80% off the window high (trading at 20–40% of that high), only after a green bar that does not set the high. Never top-tick. Stop 8% below the next open, target 25% above, time-stop after 8 hourly bars. Stop is filled first if a bar touches both.
recent_trades.ath_note: ATH is the max high across fetched GeckoTerminal daily candles (up to the configured limit) and hourly candles. When the free endpoint returns a shorter window, this is not a lifetime ATH. The backtest seeds its running high with daily highs that printed before the first hourly bar only.

team.model: One team, one shared paper P&L. Each trade is proposed by one agent; all six vote. Majority of voting agents approves; a Risk Manager or Bubble Map Analyst reject is a veto. X/Twitter Scout abstains while the X API is unavailable.
